A player's '''Life Force''' is all the cards in their Reserve Deck, Force Pile and Used Pile. Cards in hand, on table or in the Lost Pile are not part of it.<ref name="gl20">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Glossary, Version 2.0], Decipher (November 1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20081221001241/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf Internet Archive]. Wiki transcription: [[Decipher Glossary 2.0]]</ref><ref name="rb20">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/serules.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Rulebook, Version 2.0], Decipher (November 1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20081221001241/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/serules.pdf Internet Archive]. Wiki transcription: [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game RULEBOOK 2.0]]</ref> A player whose Life Force is completely depleted loses the game.<ref name="rb20" />

== Reserve Deck ==
After starting locations are placed, each player shuffles the rest of their deck face down to form the Reserve Deck. Cards flow from the Reserve Deck to the Force Pile to the Used Pile and back under the Reserve Deck.<ref name="rb20" /> Destiny is drawn from the top of the Reserve Deck.<ref name="gl20" />

== Force Pile ==
In the activate phase a player moves cards face down from the Reserve Deck to the Force Pile. The Force Pile is the Force available to use or to draw into hand, and it can build up over several turns.<ref name="rb20" />

== Used Pile ==
To use Force, a player moves cards one at a time from the Force Pile to the Used Pile. At the end of every turn both players re-circulate their Used Piles beneath their Reserve Decks, so the Used Pile does not build up.<ref name="rb20" />

== Lost Pile ==
Lost and forfeited cards go face up to the Lost Pile. They are generally out of the game, though some cards can retrieve them.<ref name="rb20" />

== Hand ==
Each player starts with 8 cards drawn from the Reserve Deck and later draws more from the Force Pile in the draw phase. There is no hand-size limit.<ref name="rb20" />

== Losing Force ==
When a player must lose Force, they move cards one at a time, face up, to the Lost Pile, choosing from hand or from the top of the Reserve Deck, Force Pile or Used Pile.<ref name="rb20" /> [[Force drain]]s and [[battle]] damage are the usual causes.
